system.description: When you cast this incantation, you gain the ability to see through one opaque object or surface up to 5 ft. thick as if it were transparent jelly. The effect lasts for up to one dungeon round, as long as you concentrate on the surface and do nothing else. Each spark improves the clarity of your sight: with no sparks, you can only see vague outlines and impressions of what lies beyond, while with three or more, you can see with perfect clarity.
